- "to_lulc": land cover after the change (or "" if not specified)
- "process": the process name like "deforestation" or "urbanization" (or "")
- "change_type": one of "converted", "increased", or "decreased"
- "magnitude": numeric or descriptive change amount (or "")
- "event_found": true or false
